summary: MindWalk Holdings Corp., a British Columbia-domiciled, Austin-based Bio-Native AI company listed on Nasdaq under HYFT, filed a Form 6-K with an attached press release dated October 6, 2026, outlining a market-positioning thesis rather than a transaction. The release argues enterprise ontology layers do not capture biological function and promotes ReefIQ, its governed model-agnostic biological context layer, citing MIT and Gartner adoption statistics and management commentary from CEO Dr. Jennifer Bath. No securities, ownership stakes, prices, advisors, board actions, or regulatory clocks are disclosed. Routine foreign-private-issuer disclosure; no deal terms and no risk-arb angle.
